fam.nikah.barak.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
fam.nikah.barak.translit: Baarakal-laahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr
fam.nikah.barak.meaning: May Allah bless you, and send blessings upon you, and bring you both together in good.

fam.child.refuge.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
fam.child.refuge.translit: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
fam.child.refuge.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every harmful creature, and from every harmful eye.
sources: Bukhari 3371 (the Prophet said this over his grandsons Hasan and Husayn)
